LESSON: SAFETY IN NUTRITION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods and
Topic 3.5: Safety in Nutrition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Safety in Nutrition
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What foods could be food at home, sacks) through pictures, video clips, eaten raw?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Safety in Nutrition
2. give Kenyan examples of Safety in Nutrition
3. practise a safe skill for Safety in Nutrition

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Safety in Nutrition

Teach
• Observe Safety in Nutrition in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Safety in Nutrition (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Safety in Nutrition.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Safety in Nutrition.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Safety in Nutrition.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Safety in Nutrition.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Safety in Nutrition: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What foods could be food at home, sacks) through pictures, video clips, eaten raw?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Safety in Nutrition with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
